Metadata.title: Joyo – Learning feels like play
Metadata.description: Interactive learning app for children ages 2–6. Letters, shapes, numbers, and colors through adorable animal friends!

Shapes.hintCircle: A circle is perfectly round — like the sun or a ball!
Shapes.hintSquare: A square has 4 equal sides — like a window or a gift box!
Shapes.hintTriangle: A triangle has 3 sharp corners — like a mountain or pizza!
Shapes.hintStar: A star has 5 points — you see them twinkling at night!
Shapes.hintHeart: A heart has a dip at the top and a point at the bottom!

Letters.hintA: A is for Apple 🍎 — A makes the 'ah' sound!
Letters.hintB: B is for Ball ⚽ — B makes the 'buh' sound!
Letters.hintC: C is for Cat 🐱 — C makes the 'kuh' sound!
Letters.hintD: D is for Dog 🐶 — D makes the 'duh' sound!
Letters.hintE: E is for Egg 🥚 — E makes the 'eh' sound!
Letters.hintF: F is for Fish 🐟 — F makes the 'fff' sound!
Letters.hintG: G is for Grape 🍇 — G makes the 'guh' sound!
Letters.hintH: H is for Hat 🎩 — H makes the 'huh' sound!
Letters.hintI: I is for Ice 🧊 — I makes the 'ih' sound!
Letters.hintJ: J is for Jar 🫙 — J makes the 'juh' sound!
Letters.hintK: K is for Kite 🪁 — K makes the 'kuh' sound!
Letters.hintL: L is for Lion 🦁 — L makes the 'lll' sound!
Letters.hintM: M is for Moon 🌙 — M makes the 'mmm' sound!
Letters.hintN: N is for Nest 🪺 — N makes the 'nnn' sound!
Letters.hintO: O is for Orange 🍊 — O makes the 'oh' sound!
Letters.hintP: P is for Pig 🐷 — P makes the 'puh' sound!
Letters.hintQ: Q is for Queen 👑 — Q makes the 'kwuh' sound!
Letters.hintR: R is for Rain 🌧️ — R makes the 'rrr' sound!
Letters.hintS: S is for Sun ☀️ — S makes the 'sss' sound!
Letters.hintT: T is for Tree 🌳 — T makes the 'tuh' sound!
Letters.hintU: U is for Umbrella ☂️ — U makes the 'uh' sound!
Letters.hintV: V is for Violin 🎻 — V makes the 'vvv' sound!
Letters.hintW: W is for Whale 🐋 — W makes the 'wuh' sound!
Letters.hintX: X is for X-ray 🩻 — X makes the 'ks' sound!
Letters.hintY: Y is for Yarn 🧶 — Y makes the 'yuh' sound!
Letters.hintZ: Z is for Zebra 🦓 — Z makes the 'zzz' sound!

Numbers.hint2: 2 goes around and back along a track!
Numbers.hint3: 3 has two big curves like a butterfly!
Numbers.hint4: 4 goes down, across, and down some more!
Numbers.hint5: 5 has a straight neck, round tummy, and a hat!

Colors.hintRed: Red is like an apple or a fire truck! 🍎
Colors.hintBlue: Blue is like the sky or the ocean! 🌊
Colors.hintYellow: Yellow is like the bright sun or a banana! ☀️
Colors.hintGreen: Green is like the grass or the leaves on trees! 🌿
Colors.hintPurple: Purple is like sweet grapes or a magical flower! 🍇
